title: Voice logging for meals and exercise across the app
context: speech_to_text is already in pubspec. Testers want: say any meal anywhere and it logs; say walking and it logs burnt calories. Egyptian Arabic speech support is a plus, not a blocker.
tasks: Mic button on home hero + meal capture: 'سجلت 3 كوبات شاي وبيضة' -> parse to items + approx kcal (always show ≈)
Walk tab: 'مشيت 40 دقيقة' -> log exercise session with ≈ kcal estimate
Parsing fallback: if AI parse fails, show what we heard and let user correct - never silent fail, zero-blame copy
Tests for the parser with Egyptian Arabic samples
